description: IN-CONTEXT GOLDEN (ASM-A3-IN-CONTEXT), A3's rail-spacing edit: two A3 rails (MGN12 stand-ins, 350 x 12 x 8, fourteen r1.75 through holes at x = 12.5 + 25k, y = 0) grounded at (25, +-45, 10), and the carriage plate (120 x 140 x 8 centred on its origin) grounded at (200, 0, 26). The plate's second sketch holds two circles projected IN CONTEXT from each rail's hole 8 (rail-local centre (187.5, 0), top rim z = 8), cut through the plate. The stored links still hold the values resolved when the rails were at +-40: the evaluation must re-resolve them at +-45, cut the holes there, and report them changed. Locks: the link resolves against the referenced occurrence's solved pose, is carried into the host occurrence's frame, and the host part is rebuilt from it before the result is built.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED, not recorded pipeline output. r = 1.75, A_h = pi r^2 = 9.62112750161874 mm^2.

Rail: V_r = 8 (350 x 12 - 14 A_h) = 32522.433719818702 mm^3; S_r = 2 (4200 - 14 A_h) + 8 x (2 x 350 + 2 x 12) + 14 x 2 pi r x 8 = 15154.112750161874 mm^2. The holes sit symmetrically about x = 175, so the rail's centroid is (175, 0, 4).

Link resolution: hole 8's top rim is at rail-local (187.5, 0, 8), normal +Z. Rail 1 at (25, 45, 10): world (212.5, 45, 18). Into the plate's frame (plate at (200, 0, 26), no rotation): (12.5, 45, -8). Rail 2: (12.5, -45, -8). Both radius 1.75, normal +Z. The stored values were (12.5, +-40, -8), so both are changed.

Plate: the sketch on its XY plane projects each rim along Z to a circle centred (12.5, +-45), and the cut removes two r1.75 cylinders through its 8 mm. V_p = 8 (120 x 140 - 2 A_h) = 134246.0619599741 mm^3; S_p = 2 (16800 - 2 A_h) + 8 x 520 + 2 x 2 pi r x 8 = 37897.44467859455 mm^2. Centroid x = -(2 A_h x 12.5) / (16800 - 2 A_h) = -0.01433357129609852; y = 0 (the holes are mirror images); z = 4.
Combined volume = 2 V_r + V_p = 199290.9293996115 mm^3; surface_area = 2 S_r + S_p = 68205.6701789183 mm^2.

Topology: a rail is 6 planar faces + 14 hole cylinders = 20 faces, and 12 box edges + 14 x 3 (two rims and a seam) = 54 edges; the plate is 8 faces and 18 edges (the two-hole plate of sketch-extrude-plate-2holes). Sum 48 / 126 / 3. Two parts: distinct_mesh_count 2.
tolerance_rationale: CLOSED-FORM tolerance: grounded seeds, a translation-only carry of an exact B-rep circle, and analytic prism volumes, so every value is exact to float64 round-off. Measured first (2026-10-15, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): link centres exact, volume and area within 4e-11, centroid within 4e-15 mm. 1e-9 matches the other assembly goldens. Loosening it requires a reviewed justification here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.
